caption: The drawing depicts two textile objects positioned separately on a plain, light beige background. The upper object is a roughly triangular or wedge-shaped piece of lace textile, beige in color, featuring a scalloped edge along the long side and a pattern of embroidered flowers with stems and leaves. The floral pattern is distributed along the lower edge of the lace, with fine detailing and delicate texture. The lower object is a rectangular strip of fabric, also in a light beige shade, with lace trim attached to one long edge. The lace trim has a scalloped border and a simple decorative pattern, and there is a loose dark thread hanging from the left end of the strip. The overall composition is minimal, with the two textile samples drawn with fine detail and subtle shading, and ample blank space surrounding them.
title: Darned Collar & Pattern of Embroidery
